# Fold POS

> Point of sale and operations software for laundromats, dry cleaners and tailors, built by Fold Laundry. Fold POS rings up wash & fold by the pound, dry cleaning by the piece and alterations by the task on one counter, then follows every order from drop-off to pickup — with machines, supplies, pickup & delivery routes, marketing, staff shifts and printing in the same screen. Plans are $39, $59 and $79 a month, month-to-month, with a 14-day free trial and no card up front.

Fold POS runs in a browser, as a Mac or Windows app, or on an iPad, and prints to the Epson, Bixolon, Star and Zebra printers a shop already owns. "Hey Fold", a voice assistant that takes an order by speech and sends it to the printer, is built into every plan. Markdown mirrors of each page are linked below; each HTML page also declares its mirror with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

## Product

- [Fold POS home](https://foldpos.com/fold-pos.md): What Fold POS is, who it is for, and every part of it in one page — counter, orders board, floor map, delivery, back office, pricing.
- [All features](https://foldpos.com/features.md): The nine feature areas in depth — counter, workflow board, ticket, machine management, floor plan, supplies, marketing, pickup & delivery, staff & shifts.
- [Pricing](https://foldpos.com/pricing.md): Starter $39, Growth $59 and Pro $79 a month, what each plan includes, the 14-day free trial, and payments on the shop's own processor.
- [FAQ](https://foldpos.com/faq.md): Getting started, pricing and the trial, printers and the print helper, switching from Cents or CleanCloud, payments, Hey Fold, pickup & delivery, and how Fold POS relates to Fold.
- [Help center](https://foldpos.com/help.md): Short how-tos: set up a store, connect a printer, import data, use Hey Fold, add staff, customer texts, delivery, plan & billing.
- [About](https://foldpos.com/about.md): Why Fold Laundry built Fold POS, and what it cares about.

## By shop type

- [For laundromats](https://foldpos.com/laundromats.md): Wash & fold by the pound, a live floor map of every washer and dryer, machine and vending stock, delivery routes.
- [For dry cleaners](https://foldpos.com/dry-cleaners.md): Per-piece tickets, heat-seal garment tags, conveyor slots, alterations on the same ticket, wash & fold and pickup & delivery.
- [For tailors and alterations shops](https://foldpos.com/alterations.md): Per-task pricing, measurements, photos and notes on every ticket, due-date reminders, and none of the laundry screens.

## Getting started

- [Store setup guide](https://foldpos.com/setup.md): Seven short steps to open a shop on Fold POS — account, browser, price list import, printer, staff, customer texts, first order.
- [Printers](https://foldpos.com/printers.md): Supported receipt and tag printers (Epson, Star, Bixolon, Zebra), barcode scanners, and how each browser connects.
- [Fold print helper](https://foldpos.com/download.md): The small Windows program that lets any browser print receipts and garment tags, and how to pair it with a six-digit code.
- [Sign up](https://pos.foldpos.com/signup): Start the 14-day free trial; no card up front.
- [Log in](https://pos.foldpos.com/login): The Fold POS app itself.
